name: consecutive_mul
description: II=1: MULを毎サイクル発行する。各結果はs+2から見え、Computeポートは境界ごとに1回だけ使う
program: @0: mul r4, r1, r2      ; r4 = 6,  visible from 2
@1: mul r5, r1, r3      ; r5 = 8,  visible from 3
@2: mul r6, r4, r1      ; r6 = 12, visible from 4
@3: mul r7, r5, r1      ; r7 = 16, visible from 5
@5: halt                ; the last MUL completes at E_5 = h
